answer: Price the fleet, not the identity. Key pairs are free to forge, so charge each new account the real cost of a distinct path: own egress, own hardware root, own payment rail. Weight then scales with the independent paths an operator actually pays for, so the fable of ten thousand free clones collapses to whichever paths are real. Duplicates fall out of replay matching, not name checks, and a whisper of shared infrastructure is enough to link the set and cut it.
